questions.text: Describe a hobby you would like to take up.
questions.say: Thank you. Now, in Part 2, I'm going to give you a topic, and I'd like you to talk about it for one to two minutes. Before you talk, you'll have one minute to think about what you're going to say. You can make some notes if you wish. Here is your topic. Describe a hobby you would like to take up. You should say: what the hobby is; how you found out about it; what you would need to start it; and explain why you would like to take up this hobby.

questions.text: Do you think you will start this hobby soon?
questions.say: Thank you. Do you think you will start this hobby soon?

questions.text: Why is it important for people to have hobbies?
questions.say: Thank you. We've been talking about a hobby you would like to take up, and I'd like to discuss with you some more general questions related to this. Let's consider first of all hobbies. Why is it important for people to have hobbies?
